items.about:
I am a La Jolla native and active Realtor specializing in the Coastal La Jolla & San Diego real estate market, with combined sales topping $365+million, with expertise in Investment and Luxury Rehab. 

I am known to say, “Real estate never sleeps” and work tirelessly around the clock and my commitment to my clients has earned respect from my colleagues and clients alike. 

Most recently I earned the Circle of Excellence Platinum Award in 2021 - the highest award for closing over $50M by the San Diego Association of Realtors and SD Union Tribune, in addition to some the following accolades:

- “Best Real Estate Agent in La Jolla" by La Jolla Light (October, 2005)
- The Chairman Circle Gold Award (2005)
- The Platinum Sales Award (2006)
- The Leading Edge Society Award (2007, 2009 & 2010)
- The Honor Circle Award (2008)
- Platinum Award (2011 - 2014)
- Top Producers Group (2026)

I pride myself on being knowledgeable of the area and its history and I work diligently to stay informed about the marketplace both locally and nationally, informing my clients of current market trends that may affect their real estate decisions. 

My ultimate goal is to protect YOUR personal investments.

I am backed by "The Jim McInerney Real Estate Team," including multiple sales associates, marketing staff, a short sale negotiator, transaction coordinator, and an office manager, all of whom provide “white glove” service to every client. It’s nice to have peace of mind during the escrow process.

It’s in our blood to deliver a new level of service to real estate, and it’s our purpose to bring true personal connection back to how business is being conducted. We aspire to make real change within our industry and pledge to fearlessly lead by example day in and day out. 

Owning a piece of San Diego's coastal property is an aspiration for most, and we believe it should be met only with the most exceptional experience. Real estate is one of the most substantial investments one embarks on, and equally one of a person's largest assets when it comes time to sell. Although we acknowledge money is an important factor in doing business, it’s not our sole purpose. We believe focus should remain on serving the client and going above and beyond to ensure their satisfaction.

No matter how much technology improves access to the real estate market, there will always be a real need for trustworthy agents to confidently bridge the gap between buyer and seller.

Believe in finding the balance between classic values and modern practice to create symbiotic relationships that last, where the power between client and agent is equal.

publications.title: HOW WE WORK WITH BUYERS
publications.description:
At Jim McInerney Real Estate, we are full-time professionals dedicated to providing potential buyers with honesty, integrity, and confidentiality.
We provide fast, responsive attention and regular communication. Our agents will successfully handle the maze of paperwork associated with purchasing a new home, and save you money by negotiating the purchase contract up front.
We are committed to fulfilling your needs. As a client of Jim McInerney Real Estate, we will personally promote your needs to over 150 agents located within your search criteria and follow up on all leads.
We negotiate and obtain the best terms. Once we find you the home of your dreams, we effectively represent you in all due diligence of the purchase. We coordinate and oversee all aspects of the escrow process, including all inspections, repair work, loan processing, title work, disclosures, and insurance clearance. Of course, we are also available for any questions that arise after the close of escrow.
As an added advantage, Jim McInerney Real Estate also has access to properties before they hit the market. Given the low inventory we are witnessing in the current market place, this provides a huge benefit to our customers.
At the end of the day, the success of our business relies on providing excellent service. Most of our clients are repeat sellers, buyers, or referrals, and we have a list of recent client references that would welcome your call.  Just ask.

publications.title: HOW WE WORK WITH SELLERS
publications.description:
Jim McInerney Real Estate's white-glove service takes the stress out of the home selling process. We follow a 17-point system to get properties sold, a task that we are very successful at. Just last year, we assisted our clients in selling $17,000,000 in real estate. 

When you list your home with us, our objectives are as follows:
Assist in getting as many qualified buyers as possible into your home until it is sold
Communicate to you weekly the results of our activities 
Assist you in negotiating the highest dollar value.
As a client of Jim McInerney Real Estate, you will feel like our only client. We do substantial research before listing your property for sale. We analyze all the variables that will ultimately bring you the highest sale price in the time you want. We will always be physically present for all showings and pre-qualify all potential buyers. We also have creative marketing and sales ideas that have brought our clients much success.

Jim McInerney Real Estate's agents are full-time professionals with the purpose of developing clients for life. We want you to be so happy with our service that you passionately refer your friends and family. 
We look forward to servicing your property and seamlessly taking care of all the steps along the way.

organizations.name: The Greater San Diego Association of REALTORS®
organizations.description:
The Greater San Diego Association of REALTORS® is dedicated to the preservation of private property rights and to the promotion and protection of the business interests of our REALTOR® members. 

The History of the Greater San Diego Association of REALTORS® 
In 1878 the first real estate board of San Diego was organized by Cyrus Arnold. It was known as the Real Estate Association of San Diego. In 1905 a new board was formed, the San Diego Realty Board. Percy H. Goodwin was its first president. 

The purposes of the new board were set as follows: "To secure for its members the benefits of united efforts and concentrated power to the end that the evils and annoyances now connected with the transaction of business in real estate brokerage shall be abated; to promote good fellowship and fair dealing in such business to protect both its members and the public in general from irresponsible, unprincipled and dishonest dealers in real estate; to promote enactment of legislation for the protection of property rights and the dealings pertaining thereto and to do all in the power of the Board and its members, which may lead to the up building, the stability and the dignity of the business of dealing in Real Estate."

organizations.name: The National Association of REALTORS® (NAR)
organizations.description:
The National Association of REALTORS®, “The Voice for Real Estate,” is America’s largest trade association, representing 1 million members, including NAR’s institutes, societies and councils, involved in all aspects of the residential and commercial real estate industries.
Our membership is composed of residential and commercial REALTORS®, who are brokers, salespeople, property managers, appraisers, counselors and others engaged in all aspects of the real estate industry. Members belong to one or more of some 1,400 local associations/boards and 54 state and territory associations of REALTORS®, or to one of 81 cooperating associations in nearly 60 countries. They are pledged to a strict Code of Ethics and Standards of Practice.

Working for America's property owners, the National Association provides a facility for professional development, research and exchange of information among its members and to the public and government for the purpose of preserving the free enterprise system and the right to own real property.

The term REALTOR® is a registered collective membership mark that identifies a real estate professional who is a member of the National Association of REALTORS® and subscribes to its strict Code of Ethics.
